title: Design system — Near blank
description: The floor: grays, graphite actions and one blue accent. Complete, but plain.
forWho: Anyone starting a design system from almost nothing

spec.useCase: Noor Haddad starts Plainfield Works's design system from the Near blank starter and adapts it to the brand.

business.name: Plainfield Works
business.describes: A two-person app studio that wants a clean starting point.

tiles.title: Design system — Near blank
tiles.hero:
Design system

Start here.
Make it yours.

A plain, complete system: grays, one accent and the fewest choices.

ColorsTypeSpacingComponents
tiles.text:
## Principles

- Start small: add a token only when two screens need it.
- One accent: blue marks links and focus, nothing else.
- Name by role, never by value: primary, not graphite.

## Starter profile

- **Fits:** any.
- **Mood:** calm; density medium; shape soft; contrast standard; light first.
- **Type:** system-ui, ui-monospace.
- **Adapt first:** primary, link, ring, font. **Keep:** foreground, background, muted-foreground.

## Using tokens

Use a token by its name, never its value. Change a value here and every screen and every component sample below follows: colors, type, spacing, corners, shadows, opacity and motion. Each color shows its light and dark values and is checked against the color it is read on.

## Using components

Build screens from the components in this system. Each one is drawn below in its states, with a note on when to use it. When one is missing, add a row to Components.

## Accessibility

Text reaches 4.5:1 against what it sits on; control edges and focus 3:1. Focus is always visible. Nothing is told by color alone.
